notes.title: Oceanarium and Headquarters Update is live!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We are happy to give you a new Oceanarium and Headquarters Update. We are gradually improving the game design and adding new content for you. It takes time and effort to introduce all of our ideas into the game, so we will deliver them in parts across future updates.

[h3][b]Oceanarium and Headquarters update is up![/b][/h3]

[b]Watch the trailer here[/b]: [previewyoutube=roo3mW2NnEA;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][b]Patch Notes:[/b][/h3]

[list]
[*] Player's Headquarters - a new location that improves the management of player's resources and provides a place for a few mechanics that we are planning to add to the game. This is the place where you can unpack newly purchased tools, decide what to bring on the next mission, and many more in the future.
[*] Tablet CatDroid v0.1 - replacement for old Hub. In the future, it will gain more features and will become the center of many important mechanics. For now, it has two available applications: Shop and E-mails.
[*] Oceanarium - Janusz Blob has a new task for you. Help him restore the home of many exotic fish to its old pride.
[*] New tools:
[*]   Rebreather - allows to dive in deep water
[*]   Telescopic wiper - long-range tool to clean where others can't
[*]   Aquarium salt - make the water more habitable
[*] New Truck - replaces the old van (from now on, the player must manually pack the car for the mission)
[*] Bug reporter - we are aware that the game is not free of bugs (we are doing what we possibly can). With this tool, you can report bugs and automatically send screenshots, save files, and log files to us. This will make reproducing and fixing bugs easier and faster.
[*] Key map - in the bottom right corner you can see what you can do at any moment.
[*] New ambient and sound effects
[*] Fixes a few major and more minor bugs
[/list]


Oh and the game is now 20% off

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2165620/Pool_Cleaning_Simulator/


Relax, have fun, and play!
Pool Cleaning Simulator team

notes.title: Quackdzilla update is up!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

You have probably waited for a big update, and here it is!

[h3][b]The Quackdzilla update is up![/b][/h3]

[b]Watch the trailer here[/b]: [previewyoutube=chaY9IzwU8s;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][b]Patch Notes:[/b][/h3]

[olist]
[*] New game-saving system. From now on, players can save their game state during levels
[*] Dirt detector. Players can use Pool Guy's powers to highlight remaining dirt
[*] New Aim Mode. A mode that allows players to move the washcloth and sponge without moving the character
[*] Two new missions, Tommy Quacker and Adam Salomon, await you with new challenges
[*] As many as 4 new items in the game:
- a plastic bucket thanks to which the player can carry items collectively
- metal bucket for mixing liquids
- garbage bags
- new tip for the pressure washer
[*] Improved garbage collection system. Players can now collect bulk trash into a plastic bucket. They must also put garbage bags in the bins. Each bag has its own capacity, so the player must remember to replace it regularly
[*]  Improved system for putting items into the water, such as a floater
[*] New graphic option: non-physical water. A special option for weaker computers.
[*] New appearance of characters and items in the store.
[*] Various fixes and minor bug fixes.
[*] Changelog in the game. From now on, players can see what changes have occurred in the new versions of the game in the menu
[/olist]


Oh and the game is now 20% off

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2165620/Pool_Cleaning_Simulator/


Relax, have fun, and play!
Pool Cleaning Simulator team
